summary: Inspected the latest successful NOEMA Discovery artifact (108 Crossref candidates; 30 priority: 4 RECENT_PUBLICATION, 2 UPCOMING_OR_AHEAD_OF_PRINT, 24 NEWLY_INDEXED_LEGACY), compared queue movement with 2026-09-11, and searched additional scholarly/public sources.
